textSegments: 1000W ATX 3.1 power supply with native PCIe Gen5.1 12+4pin connector, 80 PLUS 230V EU Gold efficiency, single +12V rail, DC-DC design, and ultra-quiet 140mm fan for high-performance gaming systems.

Fully compatible with Intel ATX 3.1 specifications, the Toughpower GX3 SE 1000W is engineered to support modern high-performance systems and next-generation hardware with stable and efficient power delivery.
Equipped with a native PCIe Gen5.1 12+4pin (12V-2X6) connector, the GX3 SE 1000W supports next-generation graphics cards with reliable and compliant power delivery.
Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the 12VHPWR cable.
A powerful single +12V rail combined with DC-DC conversion ensures stable and consistent power delivery for demanding CPU and GPU workloads.
Low-profile flat black cables simplify cable routing and help maintain clean system builds.

Built-in protections including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection (OTP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) safeguard your system against electrical faults, providing peace of mind and reliable operation.
Certified with 80 PLUS 230V EU Internal Gold efficiency, delivering up to 90% efficiency under typical loads for improved energy efficiency and reduced heat.
An ultra-quiet 140mm fluid bearing fan provides excellent airflow and reliable cooling performance while maintaining low noise levels.
With a compact 160mm depth, the GX3 SE 1000W fits easily into a wide range of ATX cases for flexible system builds.
